clues.text: In the land of Uz lived this blameless, upright man who feared God and shunned evil.
Satan asked the LORD if this man feared God for nothing, since a hedge protected all he owned.
A desert wind struck the oldest brother's house, and it fell on this man's feasting sons and daughters.
After losing his flocks and children, he worshiped, saying the LORD gave and the LORD has taken away.
Satan struck him with boils from head to foot, and he scraped himself with broken pottery among ashes.
Eliphaz, Bildad and Zophar came to comfort him and sat silent with him seven days and nights.
Out of a whirlwind, the LORD asked him where he was when the earth's foundations were laid.
